notes: Story c239b461 (DMT update): the Daily Mirror is a second independent publisher of the department's announcement; added as a source, validation raised to corroborated, and the summary says that bookings continue through the online portal (Daily Mirror). The build failed only on furukawa-electric-power-systems-shipment-system-2026-11, which is stored in both 2026-10 and 2026-11. Another worker rewrote the 2026-10 copy at 08:03:13Z (a date move), so that move was still in progress. The 2026-11 copy was still present after a 5-minute wait, and the build still fails on it alone; my event validates cleanly. The stale 2026-11 copy has to be removed with git mv/rm by the dispatcher or the worker that moved it. This worker did not touch either file, because workers may not delete event files or files they did not write.
